01 · Synergies

Four places where Hyatt
and Amplitude line up

Four areas where Amplitude helps hospitality data and guest experience teams turn data into action.

Amplitude · Global Agent

Follow-up question: "Show conversion rates by user segment" splits the same booking funnel by country, with drop-off detail at every step.

Sample travel dataset

Amplitude · AI Controls

AI Controls: admins turn agents on for the organization, connect Global Agent to Microsoft Teams, and add reference files so answers use Hyatt's own definitions. The Audit tab shows what people ask.

1
Self-serve insight

Ask the data in plain language

The challenge

Business users often depend on analysts and complex BI joins for answers. Leaders want to ask questions directly, and data teams want visibility into what is being asked.

How Amplitude helps

Global Agent answers in natural language and builds charts on governed data, using your own definitions. Admins can review every question asked, and MCP brings the same answers into the AI tools teams already use.

Unlocks: faster answers without new report requests, plus a live record of what leaders care about.

Global AgentAmplitude MCPAI Controls
Experiment · Personalized Content

Experiment results: a personalized banner test lifts Bookings Conversion by 26.5% and loyalty program sign-ups by 22.9% against control, with confidence intervals for each.

Demo environment example

2
Measure every change

Experimentation as a core principle

The challenge

When experimentation is a core principle, every change needs to be measured against a clear baseline, with results tied to the KPIs each business unit owns.

How Amplitude helps

Amplitude Experiment runs randomized tests on the same data model as your analytics, so results tie to the KPIs each unit already watches. Through a strategic partnership announced in May 2026, Amplitude is taking on Statsig's brand and customers and continuing to develop its cloud and warehouse-native platforms, adding depth in experimentation and feature management for technical teams.

Unlocks: A/B thinking extended to web, app, and guest-facing changes, with statistical rigor.

ExperimentFeature FlagsStatsig
Guides & Surveys

Guides & Surveys: an NPS survey on hotel search results, with targeting, trigger, and throttle controls your team sets directly.

AI Feedback

AI Feedback: guest comments grouped into a theme, linked to the session replays behind it, with an AI summary.

3
Survey consolidation

One home for the voice of the guest

The challenge

Guest surveys often live in a separate tool, away from behavioral data, and even small changes can take longer than they should.

How Amplitude helps

Guides & Surveys lets your team launch and edit in-product surveys directly. AI Feedback pulls in call center notes, support tickets, app reviews, and social posts and sorts them into themes.

  • Spot a friction point, then survey exactly those guests
  • Responses sit next to behavior, loyalty, and booking data

Unlocks: feedback you can act on where you measure it, with fewer tools and faster turnaround.

Guides & SurveysAI FeedbackCustomer Feedback Agent
Amplitude · Session Replay

Session Replay: watch the exact journey behind a score, from search and date selection to browsing rates, with every click logged on the timeline.

4
360° customer quality

The quality intelligence model

The challenge

A complete picture of guest quality combines human observation, survey feedback, and automated conversation outcomes, which usually live in separate systems.

How Amplitude helps

Amplitude's single data model can hold all three inputs as events tied to the same guest or interaction. Agent Analytics scores automated conversations on the same footing as human reviews.

Unlocks: quality scores you can segment by property, channel, or loyalty tier, and trace to the exact moments behind them.

Data connectionsAI Feedback APIAgent AnalyticsSession Replay

05 · Why Amplitude

Why teams choose
Amplitude

The reasons customers and analysts cite most often, and what each one would mean for Hyatt.

Who we are

Amplitude is a digital analytics platform for product analytics, experimentation (including the Statsig partnership for feature management and warehouse-native experimentation), audience activation, session replay, and AI agents that answer questions in natural language and turn insights into action.

More than 4,900 customers, including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square, use Amplitude to understand behavior, run experiments, and optimize digital experiences.

AnalyticsExperiment & StatsigGuides & SurveysSession ReplayAI FeedbackAudiencesAI Agents
01

Ease of use

Forrester calls Amplitude ideal "where product and marketing teams need close alignment and ease of use is a priority." On G2, ease of use is rated 86%, above the category average.

For HyattLeaders ask questions directly instead of waiting on complex BI joins.
02

Speed to answer

Forrester Customer Favorite feedback singles out query engine speed. Funnels, retention, cohorts, and paths come back interactively, not as a ticket in a queue.

Engagement, persona, and conversion driver analyses on one behavioral model, plus a dedicated storytelling tool that Forrester noted no other evaluated vendor offered.
